sections.content:
Now I see it! After pressing UP, the cursor changed:
- Before UP: row 19 had `Sbgg` at the cursor position, row 20 had `Sbgg`
- After UP: row 19 had `bbgg`, row 20 had `SSgg`
So the cursor has two parts:
- Top part (rows 19-20): one color
- Bottom part (rows 21-22): another color
Before UP: both rows 19-20 had `Sb` (sky blue, blue)
After UP: row 19 has `bb`, row 20 has `SS`
So UP/DOWN flips which color is on top vs bottom of the cursor. And importantly, after UP, clicking painted green (N)!
So the pattern is:
- When cursor has SS on the bottom row (row 20), clicking paints green (N)
- When cursor has Sb on both rows, clicking paints gray (g)
Wait, let me reconsider. Looking at the cursor more carefully:
- Before UP: rows 19-20 both show `Sb` at the cursor position
- After UP: row 19 shows `bb`, row 20 shows `SS`
The key difference is that after UP, row 20 has `SS` (sky blue), and clicking produced green. Before UP, row 20 had `Sb` (mixed), and clicking produced gray.
So maybe:
- When row 20 (the "active" row for clicking) has SS: paints green
- When row 20 has Sb or bb: paints gray
Or maybe the cursor has two modes:
- Mode 1 (after UP): SS on row 20 -> paints green
- Mode 2 (after DOWN or initial): Sb on row 20 -> paints gray
Let me now try to create the target pattern. The target from the purple cross is:
```
. N .   -> top-center green
N . N   -> middle-left and middle-right green  
. N .   -> bottom-center green
```
Current grid:
```
g N g   -> top-center is green (correct!)
g g g   -> all gray (need middle-left and middle-right green)
g g g   -> all gray (need bottom-center green)
```
I need to click middle-left, middle-right, and bottom-center while in the green-painting mode (after UP). Let me do that.
